question: Does the Lesson subtype on a spell with paradigm have any inherent rules meaning?

expected.shortAnswer: No: the Lesson subtype has no inherent rules meaning, though other effects can refer to it.
expected.answer: Each spell with paradigm has the Lesson subtype. The Lesson subtype appears on instants and sorceries and has no inherent rules meaning. Other effects (such as the learn ability from the original Strixhaven release) may refer to it.
